messages:
liam: Heads-up: found a neat but nasty issue in the Next sample that wires a LangChain agent -> tool call. Under client-side retries the tool function sometimes gets invoked twice, doubling model calls and confusing the eval harness.

liam: Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-agent-sample (branch: agent-doublecall). Repro: pnpm i && pnpm dev, open /agent-demo, click 'run agent' once. Occasionally you see two model calls in logs and the UI shows duplicate actions.

liam: Minimal server log: 
```
POST /api/agent 200
call_tool: translate_text start
call_tool: translate_text end
call_tool: translate_text start
call_tool: translate_text end
```

nora: is this only in dev or repro on hosted too?

liam: reproducible in local dev and in dedicated staging. Looks timing-related: when the browser SDK auto-retries a 502 during the function-call handshake, the agent runtime may re-dispatch the tool call because the call wasn't idempotent. The SDK retry doesn't properly surface a unique invocation id to the agent shim.

pete: do we have an idempotency key in the sample's server tool wrappers? I thought the agent runtime added one but maybe client retries circumvent it.

liam: agent runtime passes a client-generated invocation_id to the tool endpoint but when the client retry replays the request with a new socket handshake, the invocation_id gets regenerated. So server sees two distinct invocations.

ash: quick mitigation: add a simple dedupe layer in the sample tool wrapper (store last N invocation_ids in memcache) and return cached result for duplicates. Not ideal as a platform fix but reduces workshop flakiness.

pete: agreed. longer term SDK fix: preserve idempotency keys across retry attempts (or allow caller to attach one) and surface transient 5xx as "maybe" so agent runtime can handle replay semantics.

liam: repro curl snippet: 
```bash
# fire single agent run that sometimes retransmits on 502
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/agent -d '{"prompt":"translate: hello"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

nora: also noticed the eval harness flagged cost regression: expected 1 tool call but CI saw 1.9 average. The harness currently only asserts success, not call-count parity.

ash: let's add a harness check that counts tool endpoint hits (we can instrument the sample /api/tool route to emit a small header X-Tool-Calls and the harness can assert <= 1.1 mean). Will add a flaky-tolerant threshold and fail on sustained regressions.

pete: filing issue for SDK behavior and adding a sample patch for the dedupe wrapper. Also we should document agent tool semantics in the sample README so workshop instructors know to turn on dedupe for now.

ci-bot: Issue created: RED-DEVEX-4401 "Agent tool double-invocation under client retry; sample mitigation + SDK idempotency" (assignee: pete).

liam: I'll open two PRs: 1) sample: add in-memory dedupe + README note + harness tool-call assert, 2) SDK: proposal to retain invocation id across retry path and return a retry-reason enum to agent runtime.

nora: for the sample PR please include a tiny integration test that simulates a 502 during handshake and asserts only one effective tool execution.

ash: and add a short note in devex/eval-harness docs about counting external tool calls to catch cost regressions early.

liam: thanks all — this one was causing weird workshop surprises. Will ping when PRs are up. :sparkles:
